# er605 Provider

TP-Link ER605 (standalone mode) via the router's web API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    er605 = {
      source = "gzamboni/er605"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials can also come from ER605_URL / ER605_USERNAME / ER605_PASSWORD.
provider "er605" {
  url      = "http://192.168.0.1" # the router's HTTPS only speaks legacy TLS
  username = "admin"
  password = var.router_password
  timeout  = 90
}

variable "router_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification when url is https.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password (env ER605_PASSWORD).
- `timeout` (Number) Per-request timeout in seconds. Default 60; the router can take 5-35 s to apply a change.
- `url` (String) Router base URL. Default http://192.168.0.1 (env ER605_URL). The router's HTTPS only speaks legacy TLS; prefer http on the LAN.
- `username` (String) Admin user (env ER605_USERNAME).
